text: yes lets hit them, take out some big wins, they all seem rather straight forward
resolution: Landed the packing series in three commits. (1) a561b6193: every per-frame 2D instance row slimmed — CapsuleInstance 48->24B, TriInstance 80->36B, GCurveFillInstance 40->28B, CurveInstance 64->32B (plus unreachable dash params stripped), GlyphInstance 72->48B, RectInstance 104->68B, SdfIconInstance 56->32B; new shared framework/gpu/pack.zig owns the quantizers; ~120MB reclaimed and dense-chart per-frame upload roughly halved. (2) 5d15ce41e: the universal mesh Vertex packed 32->20B (pos f32x3 + octahedral snorm16x2 normal + f16x2 uv) with packing at the upload boundary only — authoring/wire/mapfile stay raw f32 per V29; the 256MiB retained buffer now holds 13.4M verts instead of 8.4M, easing the cache-full silent mesh drops. (3) 0979c27cf: lod_budget stops counting slim-pool foliage rows against MAX_STATIC_INSTANCES, so the far LOD shell isn't clamped to 0 on big maps — the open tail of the flora series. Verified: editor builds green and full-scene self-shots render identical (shots/slim_pools_check.png, shots/slim_vertex_check.png).
